indicator_name: Gross value added by industry division (ОКЭД 05–39), year-to-date
description: Валовая добавленная стоимость по отраслям промышленности, нарастающим итогом с начала года
methodology: Period rows «1 квартал 2013 года» … «I квартал 2026 года» of the national block; the 2018 overlap resolves to the later sheet. Same columns as GVA_NOMINAL_INDUSTRY_DIVISIONS.
transformation: level (year-to-date cumulative, as published -- not decumulated to discrete quarters)
